items.title: Gabriel Birnbaum: Building a Business

items.title: Owls Bowl Bound after Scoring 60 Against First-Place UTSA
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football is bowl eligible for the sixth time in program history, and first since 2020, after defeating (RV) UTSA, 60-29, Thursday night on Howard Schnellenberger Field at Flagler Credit Union Stadium. Six wins are the program's most since 2019, and its best record through nine games since the same year.

items.title: Chandley Named to Midseason Ray Gay Watch List
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's junior P Reed Chandley has been named to the 2026 Ray Guy Award Midseason Watch List, announced by the Augusta Sports Council on Thursday.

items.title: Florida Atlantic’s Messer Named a Burlsworth Trophy Nominee
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's fifth-year WR Easton Messer has been named one of 65 nominees for the 2026 Burlsworth Trophy, recognizing outstanding college football players who began their careers as walk-ons.

items.title: Inside the Owls’ Burrow S11, E12
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Inside the Owls' Burrow, the official weekly television show for Florida Atlantic Athletics, will air episode 11 of season 12 this week on Thursday, Nov. 5. Every 30-minute show this season will air on The Spot stations in the South Florida market.

items.title: Know Before You Go: Football vs. UTSA
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football is back on Howard Schnellenberger Field at Flagler Credit Union Stadium for a Thursday night primetime matchup, hosting RV UTSA at 7:30 p.m. on ESPN. Sponsored by Publix, the game will be Paradise Appreciation Night.

items.title: Owls Hosting 'SportsCenter on Campus’ Before Thursday’s National TV Game vs. UTSA
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic is set to host ESPN's 'SportsCenter on Campus' on Thursday, Nov. 5, prior to the Owls hosting UTSA in a nationally televised football game on ESPN at 7:30 p.m.

items.title: Football Game Notes #9
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football is set for its second Thursday game in as many weeks, this time on Howard Schnellenberger Field at Flagler Credit Union Stadium with RV UTSA coming to town. The program's first regular season home game on the flagship station kicks off at 7:30 p.m.

items.title: Owls’ Football at Tulsa Announced for 3:30 p.m. on ESPN+
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football will face American Conference foe Tulsa on the road Saturday, Nov. 14, kicking off at 3:30 p.m. ET on ESPN+ as announced by the league on Monday.
